name: Chandler Swale
title: Saltmere Stores
examine: A man shelved as neatly as his stock. If he has ever been caught without, nobody has caught him at it.
lines: Rope, tar, biscuit. Ask for stranger and I'll surprise you.
Everything here earns its shelf. The shelf is the interview.
Boots, line, lamp oil. In that order, if you're walking back north.
